A Perfectly Ordinary Post

This paragraph carries an inline event handler that must not survive extraction, because the archive renders decade-old markup in the reader's own browser and on the reader's own origin.

Here is a link that is not a link and here is a genuinely relative one that has to be resolved before it is stored, or it will resolve against the archive instead.

The body text itself is ordinary and should come through intact, which is the point: sanitization must remove the dangerous parts without damaging the article that a reader actually wants to keep and read years from now.
